subject: TEST RESULT: bounded ordered hinge mailbox Kotlin prototype compiles and passes 5/5
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-hinge-ingress-edge-preservation-20261002. Created a pure-Kotlin R&D mailbox prototype that preserves source order + observedUptimeMs, permits exactly one posted drain per pending window, bounds memory, and reports overflow explicitly instead of silently latest-only collapsing. Initial compile exposed ArrayDeque API mismatch; prototype was corrected to java.util.ArrayDeque and rebuilt from scratch. Final kotlinc compile PASS; executable JVM checks PASS 5/5: one drain scheduling, order/time/sequence preservation, rescheduling after drain, explicit bounded overflow retaining newest capacity, invalid sample rejection. This prototype does NOT integrate into production and does NOT yet implement coordinator fail-closed overflow recovery; those remain manual architectural integration work.
